title: Make room for the beginner in the room
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Show the local map — Explain owners, help routes, and boundaries.; Keep the learner active — Let them predict, act, and interpret.; Notice recurring gaps — Separate teaching needs from broken instructions.; Repair the path — Review changes with an established owner.; Repeat independently — Use a fresh walkthrough to check clarity..
